description: INTO THE RAVE III Hosted by FALC’OHM SYSTEM x GAZMATEK Round three for INTO THE RAVE! After two wild editions, we’re taking over La Fabriek once again with Falc’ohm System and Gazmatek joining forces. Those who were there know what’s up — the last ones went off hard, the crowd was on fire all night long. This time we’re pushing it even further with a 100% Live Set – no USBs, no sync, just pure passions and skills with machines. Get ready for a rough ride through acid techno, acidcore, tribe, hardtek and all the underground shades we live for. La Fabriek – Brussels Saturday 06.12.2025 – 22h → 06h LINE-UP (100% live) Dj Lemma Albiovix Olibrius SHMYKBLICK Staterak Kemikal crow RK project Gazmatek/Falc'ohm Soundsystem 100% Live Set Line-up Unique lightshow Lasershow Psychedelic décoration Secret Happening Care team Only positive vibes TICKETS • EARLY BIRD : 8€ • WAVE 2 : 12€ • FINAL WAVE : 15€ • DOORS : 15€ TIMES 22:00 → 06:00 RULES No drugs – No dogs – No graffiti 18+ only Back to the roots. Back to the rave. One room, two crews, pure live energy. Let’s dive INTO THE RAVE.  Anderlecht
